newsitem.title: JORDAN: King Hussein departs on European tour.
newsitem.headline: King Hussein departs on European tour.

text.p: Jordan's King Hussein departed on Tuesday on a four-nation European tour to Netherlands, France, Switzerland and Britain to hold talks on the Middle East peace process and economic aid to his kingdom, a palace official said.

The king will start his tour in Amsterdam, before departing to Paris for a two-day visit from June 11-12 where he will address a joint meeting of French and Jordanian businessmen to promote investment ties, the official said.
The monarch will then head to Switzerland where he is due to deliver a speech at the ILO (International Labour Organisation) conference in Geneva.

A private visit to Britain on the last leg of his tour tentatively includes plans for the king's first meeting with British Prime Minister Tony Blair since he came to power in a landslide election victory last month.
